Definition: to rush; by implication, to desolate
BiblicalUsage: 1) crash, make a din or crash, crash into ruins, be in ruins, be desolated; 1a) (Qal) to crash into ruins; 1b) (Niphal); 1b1) to be ruined; 1b2) to crash; 1b3) to be left (a desolation); 1c) (Hiphil); 1c1) to cause to crash; 1c2) to cause to be desolated
